pages.title: In the water
text: The March's meres, pools and tarns are full of life.
All of them keep to open water under the sky, never the water sealed in the rock below.

pages.title: Glimmerfin
text: Small neon fish with lit fins that swim in shoals, in the water of every land. Catch one in a water bucket, or cook it.

pages.title: Drift Bell
text: A slow, glowing jelly shaped like a bell, in the water of every land but the Highlands and the Ember Wastes. Harmless. Its **Drift Jelly** lets you breathe underwater and see in the dark for a while.

pages.title: Veil Ray
text: A wide, shy manta of the Steppe, the Highlands, the Reed Fen and the Shallows; it glides away from anyone who comes near. Drops March Leather and Glimmerfin.

pages.title: Silt Eel
text: An olive fen eel of the Reed Fen's pools and channels, the Shallows, and the water where the Ember Wastes run down to the sea. It swims with the Glimmerfin and bites anyone wading in its water. Cook it into a Smoked Silt Eel for a good meal.

pages.title: Loom Swift
text: **Loom Swifts** wheel over the open land in loose flocks of **3 to 6**, only by day and in dry weather, and never over the Ember Wastes; no more than **12** gather around you. They drop a feather or two, now and then some Raw Game.

pages.title: In the air
text: Closer to the ground the air is busy with insects: **fireflies** over the fen and steppe at night, **reed darters** skimming the water by day, **glasswings** fluttering over the blooms of the Crystal Fields, and **cinder gnats** drifting up from the Ember Wastes. They are only light and motion; they cannot be caught, and they cost your world nothing.

pages.title: Herds come back
text: Hunt or tame a stretch of the March bare and it will not stay bare. About **once a minute**, at a quiet spot **32 to 96 blocks** from you and never within **24 blocks** of anyone, a few animals of that land may wander back in: the same grazers its land began with, including any that other mods add there. Cave and lava dwellers return to their own ground.

They stop coming once about **six** animals live within 32 blocks of the spot. Tame and penned animals count too, so land refills to roughly how it began and no further, and wild herds never crowd your farms or a busy camp.
Fish, jellies and swifts come and go with the water and sky on their own. Server settings can change the pace, or turn the return off.

pages.title: Feeding and breeding
text: Hold **Ribbon Weed** or **seagrass** and Glimmerfin, Drift Bells and Veil Rays swim to you, even the shy rays. Feed two of a kind and they make a third.

A **fishing rod** cast in any March water pulls up Raw Glimmerfin, and one cast in four a Raw Silt Eel, in place of cod and salmon. Hold an **empty bucket** in your other hand and a glimmerfin comes up alive, as a Bucket of Glimmerfin: the easy way to stock a pond.
Hold **wheat seeds** or **Steppe Grain** and Loom Swifts wheel in close around you, near enough to feed. Two fed swifts make a third the same way.
Their young are born full grown and never wander off, so a stocked pond stays stocked. Each pair rests five minutes before it breeds again. Silt Eels take no food.
Drift Bells also drop a Slimeball now and then.
